summary_md:
# Köp dippen

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-11-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

DI's Kort & Lång (2 Nov 2026) covers the continued AI-driven sell-off after weak US tech reports: Alphabet fell sharply on fears that AI is eating its search business, Intel dropped about 30%, and Reddit's CEO warned that language models are changing how the internet works. Higher risk-free rates mean the old 'there is no alternative' (TINA) case for equities no longer holds. A segment on high short interest in Stockholm uses MilDef, Bone Support and Kinnevik as examples where short sellers have recently been wrong, and argues that heavily shorted names can be screened as an opportunity. The hosts conclude that the US midterm elections do not threaten the AI build-out right now, and they end with a general 'buy the dip' call: the worry is overdone.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 MILDEF — MilDef | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Short interest down from 13% to 3%, stock up 110% this year and near its all-time high; short thesis has failed.

#### Reasoning

Host Mikael Olsson calls the MilDef short a thin momentum case without much fundamental support. Insider selling, a profit warning and ceasefire talk in Ukraine did not change the long-term rearmament story. He suggests going against the shorts when the case is this weak, while noting the valuation could still make it a sell for a long holder.

#### Sell Triggers

- new profit warning or revenue shifted into later quarters
- signs of a cash flow problem
- a ceasefire that cuts defence spending
- short interest starts rising again

> *"I mitt huvud känns det som ett ganska tunt momentum-case som helt enkelt inte funkar."*

---

### 🟠 BONEX — Bone Support | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Brummer's aggressive short case has not played out; short interest fell from 13% to 4% and the stock rallied on a squeeze.

#### Reasoning

Host says the short positioning was too aggressive and that sales do not support the bear case. The market does not believe the regulatory-risk argument about Cerament. Falling short interest takes away mechanical selling pressure, which is a positive read for the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- regulatory problems for Cerament come true
- sales growth disappoints
- questions about revenue recognition are confirmed

> *"Så det här är ytterligare ett fall när blankarna har visat sig ha fel."*

---

### 🟠 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Ningi short report judged overdone; short interest is still high but may be about to fall.

#### Reasoning

Host says the core of the Ningi report deserved attention but is not enough to justify a case that the company goes to zero. Kinnevik has denied the claims. Short interest has fallen in software peers (Addnode, Vitec) but not yet in Kinnevik, which he sees as a possible derivative play on software. Heavily shorted names can act as a hidden source of future buying.

#### Sell Triggers

- the related-party transaction is shown to be a real governance problem
- short interest keeps rising
- weaker software sector

> *"Där börjar det nästan kännas som att det är på väg ner."*
